name: type
what: One kind of doc: where it lives, its fields, its subtypes, who writes it and what it links to.

trace.author: agent
trace.note: A type and its schema change in the intent that needs it; brain (AIP-3) keeps them.
trace.reflection: Every new one is checked against the ones of its type that hold and says what it supersedes or merges; it is revised in place, each revision an event in the trace.
